collections.name: Signature Roses
collections.tagline: Garden roses, grown for scent and structure.
collections.description: Our house collection. Certified garden roses in the hues of the French countryside — blush, ivory, champagne and wine — hand-tied and delivered with a care card.
story: The Signature Rose is the bloom that named the house. We grow them on day-neutral California acreage, cut them at first light, and spend the morning arranging them by hand so that each rose opens in its own time.
Every bouquet in this collection is built around the architecture of the flower itself: high centres, full petal age, and a fragrance that a perfume house would photograph for reference.
collections.seoTitle: Signature Roses — Garden Rose Bouquets & Delivery
collections.seoDescription: Shop the Signature Roses collection — blush, ivory, champagne and wine garden roses, hand-tied in three sizes and delivered across the Arcadia metro.

collections.name: Birthday Flowers
collections.description: Arrangements designed to be the best part of a party — saturated tulips, ranunculus and dahlias in palettes that flatter wrapping paper and birthday tables alike.
story: Birthdays deserve flowers with an appetite for life. We lean on short, sturdy stems and colours with high saturation so the arrangement holds its sculpture through candles, cake and dancing.
Leaning bright without being brash, this collection is our most popular gift at the atelier counter.
collections.seoTitle: Birthday Flowers — Joyful Bouquets Delivered Same-Day
collections.seoDescription: Send birthday flowers that feel like confetti — bright tulips, ranunculus and dahlias, beautifully wrapped with a handwritten card.

collections.name: Wedding & Romance
collections.description: Couture florals for the most photographed moments of your life — bridal bouquets, ceremony pieces and anniversary arrangements composed with intention.
story: Whether it is a hand-tied bridal bouquet carried down an aisle or a table arrangement that holds a conversation, romance is about restraint as much as abundance.
Our wedding team books twelve consultations a month and composes every piece for the light of the venue, not the trend of the season.
collections.seoTitle: Wedding Florals — Bouquets, Ceremony & Romance Flowers
collections.seoDescription: Wedding and romance flowers from Bloomé — bridal bouquets, ceremony arches and anniversary arrangements, composed for the light of your venue.

collections.name: Sympathy & Remembrance
collections.description: Considered flowers for honouring a life — white lilies, cream roses and soft greenery, delivered with dignity and a handwritten note.
story: We take care with these arrangements that they say what words cannot: that someone is loved, and that the people carrying the grief are seen.
Sympathy orders are assembled quietly, out of traffic, and delivered in plain wrappers — never with branding on the exterior.
collections.seoTitle: Sympathy Flowers & Remembrance Bouquets — Same-Day Delivery
collections.seoDescription: Sympathy and remembrance flowers in quiet, dignified tones — white lilies, cream roses and greenery, delivered with a handwritten note.

collections.name: Seasonal Blooms
collections.description: A living collection that changes with the calendar — whatever our regional growers bring to the market this week, arranged with editorial calm.
story: Seasonality is how we stay honest and how we stay good. The Seasonal Blooms collection is composed each Monday morning from the freshest arrivals at our growers’ coolers.
Order blindly and be surprised, or browse the notes that tell you exactly which farms your stems came from.
collections.seoTitle: Seasonal Flowers — Fresh Local Arrangements by Season
collections.seoDescription: Seasonal flower arrangements composed each week from regional growers — autumn golds, winter whites, spring pastels and summer celebrations.

collections.name: Luxury Arrangements
collections.tagline: Sculptural couture pieces, by the stem.
collections.description: Our most generous work — overscale arrangements in rare blooms, finished with silk ribbons and delivered with white-glove care.
story: Luxury, at the atelier, means two things: stems that do not grow in every market, and a designer’s eye for negative space. The Luxury collection gives both full room.
Each piece is made to order, photographed in the studio, and delivered in a travelling vault that keeps the petals at 6°C until the doorbell rings.
collections.seoDescription: Sculptural luxury flower arrangements in rare blooms — orchids, peonies and garden roses, made to order and delivered by white-glove courier.

products.name: Rose Antoinette
products.shortDescription: Twelve garden roses in soft blush and cream — the bouquet that named the house.
products.description: Named for the atelier’s founding muse, Rose Antoinette is a study in blush: garden roses at their most open, gathered with cream spray roses and a whisper of silver eucalyptus. It is our most reordered arrangement, and the one we photograph for the cover of every lookbook.
careInstructions: Trim rose stems at a sharp 45° angle before arranging.
Roses drink best in lukewarm water; refresh every other day.
Keep away from fruit bowls — ethylene ages roses quickly.
Change the water every other day and stand the arrangement away from direct sun and heating vents.
products.seoDescription: Twelve garden roses in soft blush and cream — the bouquet that named the house. Available in Classic, Deluxe and Grand sizes with same-day delivery across the Arcadia metro.

products.name: Joyeux Anniversaire
products.shortDescription: Rounded ranunculus in birthday-bright coral, blush and tangerine.
products.description: The party-leader of the collection: coral ranunculus stacked beside tangerine tulips and a spray of rose confetti, wrapped in paper printed with the atelier monogram. It looks like a celebration even before the candle is lit.
careInstructions: Ranunculus stems are hollow — cut low and water them early in the day.
Cut tulip stems straight (not on an angle) — they keep growing after cutting.
Keep water level high; tulips drink noticeably overnight.
Change the water every other day and stand the arrangement away from direct sun and heating vents.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I place my order?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery needs 24–48 hours depending on your zone. Same-day delivery is available in the Arcadia Core and Harbor District zones for orders placed before 2pm and 1pm respectively. Weddings and events are booked at least four weeks ahead.

faqs.question: Is this a real shop, and will I be charged?
faqs.answer: No. This website is a demonstration template. Every product, price and review is fictional sample content, and the checkout is a demo that never processes payment or transmits an order.

faqs.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
faqs.answer: We hand-deliver across five zones — Arcadia Core, Harbor District, Westmeadow, North Hills and a Regional Courier zone up to 50 miles out. Enter your ZIP at checkout and we will show availability, delivery fees and service windows.

faqs.question: Can I choose a delivery time?
faqs.answer: You can choose a delivery date and a service window — morning, afternoon or same-day. Precise times within a window cost extra and can be arranged by calling the atelier.

faqs.question: What happens if the recipient is not home?
faqs.answer: Our couriers will leave the arrangement with a neighbour or concierge where possible, and always with a card. If no safe spot exists, we return the arrangement to the atelier and contact you to re-schedule at no delivery cost.

faqs.question: How long will my flowers last?
faqs.answer: Most arrangements remain at their best for 7–12 days, and roses often longer. Every order includes a care card; trim the stems at an angle, change the water every other day, and keep the vase away from direct sun and heating vents.

faqs.question: Can I include a personal message?
faqs.answer: Yes. On the product page you can add a handwritten gift message of up to 240 characters, and at checkout you can request that prices be hidden from the packing slip.

faqs.question: Are the flowers seasonal and locally sourced?
faqs.answer: Wherever possible. We buy from three regional growers in California and complement with fair-trade imports for varieties that cannot be grown locally. Our care pages note when a bloom is in its natural season.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faqs.answer: Orders can be changed or cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the delivery date. Because flowers are perishable, cancellations after that point may carry the cost of the arrangement, and we always refund delivery when we cannot fulfil.

faqs.question: Do you create flowers for weddings and corporate events?
faqs.answer: We do. Our events team designs installations, tablescapes and ceremony florals for weddings from six to four hundred guests, and weekly arrangements for offices and hotels. Book a consultation through our contact page.
